name: Reflex Capital
decision_note: Prague VC of Mall.cz founder Ondřej Fryc and partners; third fund closed at EUR 22m (Dec 2023); joined Supernova's Series A (Sep 2025) and FaceUp's Series A (May 2026) and led Merchantee's seed extension (Jun 2026).

evidence.quote: Uzavřel svůj třetí fond o velikosti dvaadvacet milionů eur, tedy bezmála 540 milionů korun.
Fond obecně investuje částky kolem jednoho milionu eur, někdy ke hranici dvou milionů, tedy přibližně pětadvacet až padesát milionů korun.
Kolo vedl fond Reflex Capital za účasti Czech Founders VC a Lighthouse Ventures.
Do investice se pak zapojili i stávající investoři Jiří Hlavenka, Tilia Impact Ventures a Reflex Capital spolu se skupinou andělských investorů
do kola se připojily i fondy J&T Ventures, Reflex Capital, Kaya, Credo Ventures, EQT Ventures, Wing VC a Y Combinator

analyst_notes: The investor's site gives no focus, stage or ticket statement (only '€150M invested', e3, undated, cumulative - not used as capital). Capital and ticket come from CzechCrunch 2023-12-22: third fund closed at EUR 22m (similar to Fund II); typical investment about EUR 1m, sometimes up to EUR 2m. The fund close is before the activity window; activity comes from 2025-2026 deals. Sector, stage and geography are derived from the cited deals (Merchantee - marketplace SaaS, FaceUp - compliance SaaS, Supernova - design-to-code developer tool; all Czech; seed extension and two Series A rounds); the wider portfolio also includes consumer apps (Fitify, VOS.health). Round amounts are whole rounds (Merchantee CZK 30m extension; FaceUp USD 5m Series A; Supernova USD 9.2m Series A), Reflex shares undisclosed. Fund vehicles not identified by name in ARES; only Reflex Capital SE is listed.
